questions.question: Differentiate between pseudofossil and synthetic fossil.
questions.solution_html:
• Pseudofossil vs Synthetic fossil
  • • Pseudofossil:
  • o Inorganic structure resembling fossils (0.5)
  • o Formed by natural geological processes (0.5)
  • • Synthetic fossil:
  • o Artificial/man-made replica (0.5)
  • o Used for study/display (0.5)
